customManagers.description: Tools downloaded from a GitHub release and checked against their SHA-256. Renovate reads the new hash from the release's checksums file, so the version and hash always change together.

packageRules.description: Pinned: 5.7.x rejects  entities in S3 XML responses, breaking @aws-sdk/xml-builder. Revisit when upstream regression is fixed.
